tweet.text:
Google ran Claude Opus 4.8 ten times on every task in five long agent benchmarks, then kept the run the others agreed with most.

The score went from 49.6 to 50.4. Ten times the runs for under a point.

The best of those ten averaged 63.1. Better work was in the pile. The vote couldn't find it.
